_doc: The Reverie (Levely) — the World Council, held every 4 years at Mariejois. Major political and lore-shaking events happen here; the canon Reverie Saga (Ch. 903–908) was the major reveal of Imu and the Empty Throne. Each entry: chapter, title, summary, key participants, classification.

events.title: The Reverie Begins
events.summary: The Levely opens at Mariejois. Kings and queens from 50 member nations gather. The Strawhat-aligned royals (Vivi, Rebecca, Wapol, Mansherry, Inuarashi, Nekomamushi, Neptune family) all attend.

events.title: Sabo enters the Pangaea Castle
events.summary: Sabo and the Revolutionary commanders infiltrate Mariejois to free Kuma. Confrontation with the Five Elders begins.

events.title: The Empty Throne is occupied — Imu revealed
events.summary: The Five Elders bow before the Empty Throne — and Imu sits upon it. The hidden ruler of the World Government is shown for the first time. Imu views the photographs of Luffy, Blackbeard, Shirahoshi, Vivi, and someone whose name is hidden — vowing to erase 'this lineage' from history.

events.title: Cobra confronts the Five Elders about D.
events.summary: King Cobra of Alabasta privately asks the Five Elders the meaning of the Will of D. and the truth of Lily, the lost queen of the Ancient Kingdom — making the connection that Nefertari Lily is one of the 20 founders who refused to take the Tenryubito surname.

events.title: Sabo's escape — Cobra's death (offscreen)
events.summary: Sabo escapes Mariejois and disappears. Cobra is reported dead — Sabo is framed as the killer. The truth is later revealed: Imu killed Cobra after he asked too many questions.

events.title: Sabo's broadcast — Egghead-era reveal
events.summary: Through Morgans's interview, Sabo's account of the Reverie reaches the world: he saw Imu, witnessed Cobra's death, learned of the Empty Throne. The truth begins to leak.

events.title: Lulusia is destroyed
events.summary: Imu uses the Mother Flame to vaporise the Kingdom of Lulusia from above — the first on-page demonstration of an Ancient-Weapon-tier weapon since the Void Century. The world learns nothing officially; survivors cover the news.

events.title: Aftermath — Worst Generation reshapes the world
events.summary: Wano concludes. Kaidou and Big Mom are defeated. Buggy joins the Yonko under the Cross Guild banner. Shanks and Blackbeard advance. The Reverie's secrets begin to unravel publicly. The Final Saga begins.
